name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 29 times in 9 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 55 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
